name: An agent's scopes are kept on the agent; a new credential carries exactly them
summary: What an agent may do is kept on the agent record (scopes): written when the agent is made and changed only by a renewal that sends a scopes list. A new credential (POST /v1/agents/{id}/credentials) with no list carries exactly those; no credential, working or dead, decides anything. A list that asks for nothing more is taken from the agent's account or a superuser; one that widens only from its own account, else 403. scopes must be a list of known names and the body takes only label and scopes (422). An agent made before the record kept its scopes: while its working credentials all allow the same, that is inferred (scopes_source inferred, stored by its first renewal); when none works or they differ, nothing is guessed: scopes is null and a renewal with no list is refused 409 with detail.scopes_needed, never the default four. The record carries scopes, scopes_source, scopes_differ and per credential scopes and working. The agents page shows what an agent may do, lists each credential with a Revoke button, and lets its account set the scopes under What it may do. At most 20 that work; of the dead ones the newest 5 are kept, older ones deleted (the audit log keeps the events).
